# Model class reference

Model classes are declared as mappings with an exact `type` key, for example `troposphere: {type: mendesPavlis}`. A declaration placed on a program entry overrides the one in `models:`. Every category below except `ephemerides`, `earthRotation` and `parametrization` also accepts `{type: none}`. `python -m lunarops list-classes [category]` lists the registered types.

## ephemerides

Planetary and lunar ephemerides, including the lunar orientation.

### `ephemerides: calceph` {#ephemerides-calceph}

SPICE-kernel ephemeris of BCRS body states and lunar orientation read through CALCEPH.

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `directory` | path |  | required | Directory with the SPICE kernels: at least one `.bsp` position kernel and one `.bpc` lunar-orientation kernel. |
| `lunarRelativisticScaleConvention` | string |  | required; one of `alreadyScaled`, `tdbCompatibleLunarSurface` | Coordinate scale of the lunar positions in the kernel: `tdbCompatibleLunarSurface` applies the lunar-surface scale difference L_B - L_L when forming LCRS coordinates, `alreadyScaled` applies none. |
| `longitudeLibrationCorrection` | string | `none` | one of `inpop21a`, `none` | Periodic correction added to the kernel's longitude libration: `none` or `inpop21a` (three periodic terms for INPOP21a kernels). |

## earthRotation

Earth-orientation parameters for the ITRF-GCRS transformation.

### `earthRotation: file` {#earthrotation-file}

Earth-orientation parameters linearly interpolated from a tabulated EOP file.

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | path |  | required | Native EOP file, usually the merged C04/Bulletin-A product. |
| `allowPredicted` | boolean | `true` |  | Use rows whose quality is `prediction`. If false, prediction rows are dropped and a file with `unspecified` quality is rejected. |

## troposphere

Optical tropospheric delay of each light-time leg.

### `troposphere: mendesPavlis` {#troposphere-mendespavlis}

IERS 2010 Mendes-Pavlis optical tropospheric slant delay at a laser-ranging station.

This type has no options besides `type`.

### `troposphere: none` {#troposphere-none}

Disables this model.

## relativity

Gravitational (Shapiro) delay of each light-time leg.

### `relativity: iersShapiro` {#relativity-iersshapiro}

IERS 2010 gravitational (Shapiro) path delay of a one-way light-time leg.

This type has no options besides `type`.

### `relativity: none` {#relativity-none}

Disables this model.

## stationDisplacement

Displacements of the station reference point in the ITRF. Configure a list; the displacements are summed.

### `stationDisplacement: iers2010OceanPoleTide` {#stationdisplacement-iers2010oceanpoletide}

IERS 2010 ocean pole tide loading displacement of a station.

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `coefficientFile` | path |  | required | Ocean pole-tide loading coefficient grid (IERS `opoleloadcoefcmcor.txt` format). |

### `stationDisplacement: iers2010OceanTidalLoading` {#stationdisplacement-iers2010oceantidalloading}

IERS 2010 ocean tidal loading displacement of a station from BLQ coefficients.

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `coefficientFile` | path |  | required | Ocean-loading coefficients in BLQ format. |
| `model` | string |  |  | Expected ocean-tide model name, such as `FES2022b`. The run fails if the BLQ header declares a different model. |

### `stationDisplacement: iers2010PoleTide` {#stationdisplacement-iers2010poletide}

IERS 2010 solid Earth pole tide displacement of a station.

This type has no options besides `type`.

### `stationDisplacement: iers2010SolidEarthTide` {#stationdisplacement-iers2010solidearthtide}

IERS 2010 solid Earth tide displacement of a station.

This type has no options besides `type`.

### `stationDisplacement: none` {#stationdisplacement-none}

Disables this model.

## reflectorDisplacement

Displacement of the reflector in the lunar frame.

### `reflectorDisplacement: lunarSolidTide` {#reflectordisplacement-lunarsolidtide}

Degree-2 lunar solid tide displacement of a lunar retroreflector.

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `h2` | number | `0.0423` |  | Lunar radial displacement Love number h2. |
| `l2` | number | `0.0107` |  | Lunar horizontal displacement Love number l2. |
| `moonRadiusM` | number | `1737400.0` | > 0 | Lunar reference radius of the tidal potential, in metres. |

### `reflectorDisplacement: none` {#reflectordisplacement-none}

Disables this model.

## rangeBias

Deterministic range-bias corrections subtracted from the computed round-trip time.

### `rangeBias: inpop21a` {#rangebias-inpop21a}

Additive station range-bias table of two-way corrections over UTC date intervals.

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | path |  |  | YAML range-bias table (`.yml`/`.yaml`) with `biases` rows. Only for `type: table`. |
| `source` | string |  |  | Provenance of the inline table. Only for `type: table`. |
| `biases` | list of mapping |  | at least 1 items | Inline correction rows. Only for `type: table`; give either this or `file`. |
| `biases[].station` | string |  | required | Station catalog key. |
| `biases[].start` | time |  | required | First UTC date of the correction (inclusive). |
| `biases[].end` | time |  | required | UTC date at which the correction ends (exclusive). |
| `biases[].correctionTwoWayCm` | number |  | required | Correction in centimetres of two-way light distance; it is subtracted from the computed round-trip time. Overlapping rows add up. |
| `biases[].source` | string |  |  | Provenance of the row. |

### `rangeBias: none` {#rangebias-none}

Disables this model.

### `rangeBias: table` {#rangebias-table}

Additive station range-bias table of two-way corrections over UTC date intervals.

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | path |  |  | YAML range-bias table (`.yml`/`.yaml`) with `biases` rows. Only for `type: table`. |
| `source` | string |  |  | Provenance of the inline table. Only for `type: table`. |
| `biases` | list of mapping |  | at least 1 items | Inline correction rows. Only for `type: table`; give either this or `file`. |
| `biases[].station` | string |  | required | Station catalog key. |
| `biases[].start` | time |  | required | First UTC date of the correction (inclusive). |
| `biases[].end` | time |  | required | UTC date at which the correction ends (exclusive). |
| `biases[].correctionTwoWayCm` | number |  | required | Correction in centimetres of two-way light distance; it is subtracted from the computed round-trip time. Overlapping rows add up. |
| `biases[].source` | string |  |  | Provenance of the row. |

## parametrization

Parameter blocks estimated by `LlrProcessing`.

### `parametrization: empiricalLibration` {#parametrization-empiricallibration}

Empirical periodic lunar libration corrections, cosine and sine amplitudes in milliarcseconds per term.

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `terms` | list of mapping |  | required; at least 1 items | Periodic libration terms. |
| `terms[].name` | string |  | required | Unique term name; it forms the parameter names. |
| `terms[].axis` | string | `psi` | one of `Isigma`, `psi`, `rho`, `tau`, `x`, `y` | Rotation axis of the term: `x`, `y`, `psi` (PA axes), or `rho`, `Isigma`, `tau` (physical librations referred to the J2000 mean ecliptic). |
| `terms[].delaunay` | mapping |  |  | Integer multipliers of the Delaunay arguments `l`, `lp`, `F`, `D`, `Om` that form the argument. Give either this or `periodDays`. |
| `terms[].periodDays` | number |  |  | Period of the argument, in days, counted from JD 2451545.0 of the UTC transmit epoch. Give either this or `delaunay`. |
| `terms[].cosMas` | number | `0.0` |  | A-priori cosine amplitude, in milliarcseconds. |
| `terms[].sinMas` | number | `0.0` |  | A-priori sine amplitude, in milliarcseconds. |
| `terms[].estimate` | boolean | `true` |  | Estimate the term. If false, the a-priori amplitudes are applied and kept fixed. |
| `terms[].estimateSin` | boolean | `true` |  | Estimate the sine amplitude as well as the cosine amplitude. |

### `parametrization: reflectorPosition` {#parametrization-reflectorposition}

Lunar reflector coordinates in the Moon principal-axis frame, three parameters per reflector.

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `reflectors` | list of string |  | at least 1 items; unique items | Reflector catalog keys to estimate. Defaults to every observed reflector in the catalog. |

### `parametrization: stationPosition` {#parametrization-stationposition}

LLR station ITRF reference coordinates, three parameters per station, plus optional linear velocities.

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stations` | list of string |  | at least 1 items; unique items | Station catalog keys to estimate. Defaults to every observed station in the catalog. |
| `fixedStations` | list of string |  | unique items | Station keys held at their catalog positions. |
| `estimateVelocity` | boolean | `false` |  | Also estimate the linear ITRF velocity of each station. |

### `parametrization: stationRangeBias` {#parametrization-stationrangebias}

Additive one-way station range biases in metres, one per station or per configured station interval.

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stations` | list of string |  | at least 1 items; unique items | Station catalog keys with a bias parameter. Defaults to every observed station. |
| `per` | string | `station` | one of `station`, `station+interval` | `station` estimates one bias per station; `station+interval` one bias per configured interval. |
| `intervals` | list of mapping |  |  | Bias intervals, required with `per: station+interval`. |
| `intervals[].station` | string |  | required | Station catalog key. |
| `intervals[].start` | time |  | required | First UTC date of the bias interval (inclusive). |
| `intervals[].endExclusive` | time |  | required; nullable | UTC date at which the interval ends (exclusive). Null means open-ended. |
| `intervals[].name` | string |  |  | Label of the interval; it forms the parameter name. |
